description: This file contains TypeScript code defining functions and constants related to agent command resolution, configuration loading, and MCP proxy command building for the openclaw/acpx project. It manages external dependencies, command normalization, and dynamic command generation.

methods.name: normalizeAgentName
methods.description: Trims and converts agent names to lowercase for normalization.

methods.name: quoteCommandPart
methods.description: Quotes command parts if necessary, escaping special characters.

methods.name: toCommandLine
methods.description: Joins command parts into a single command line string.

methods.name: readConfiguredAgentOverrides
methods.description: Parses agent override configurations from a given object.

methods.name: loadAgentOverrides
methods.description: Loads agent override configurations asynchronously via a spawned process.

methods.name: resolveAcpxAgentCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command for a given agent, considering overrides and built-ins.

methods.name: buildMcpProxyAgentCommand
methods.description: Builds a command string for MCP proxy with encoded payload.
